discard.title: Discard changes?
discard.body: Your unsaved changes will be lost.

archive.title: Archive product?
archive.body: This product will be removed from the active catalogue and POS. Sales and stock history will be preserved.

customerArchive.title: Archive customer?
customerArchive.body: This customer will be removed from the active customer list. Sales and invoice history will be preserved.

supplierArchive.title: Archive supplier?
supplierArchive.body: This supplier will be hidden from active supplier lists. Existing purchase history will be preserved.

categoryDelete.title: Delete category?
categoryDelete.body: This category will be permanently deleted. Products using it will become uncategorised. This action cannot be undone.

deactivateStock.title: Disable stock tracking?
deactivateStock.body: Stock tracking will be disabled for this product. Existing stock history will be preserved.

activateFixedExpense.title: Activate fixed expense?
activateFixedExpense.body: This recurring-cost template will be included in active fixed-expense totals. Historical expense records will not change.

deactivateFixedExpense.title: Deactivate fixed expense?
deactivateFixedExpense.body: This recurring-cost template will be excluded from active fixed-expense totals. Historical expense records will be preserved.

closeDay.title: Close the day?
closeDay.body: This records today's final sales, expense, and cash reconciliation figures.

lifetimeAccess.title: Grant lifetime access?
lifetimeAccess.body: This changes the client subscription to lifetime access with no recurring charge.

zatcaReconnect.title: Reconnect ZATCA production?
zatcaReconnect.body: Kubri will repeat the existing production onboarding flow for this branch. Current invoice records will not be changed.

resetLabelPreset.title: Reset label preset?
resetLabelPreset.body: Current unsaved label adjustments will be replaced with the built-in values for this preset. Branch defaults and device calibration will not change.

restoreBranchLabelDefault.title: Restore branch default?
restoreBranchLabelDefault.body: Your unsaved label changes will be replaced with the current saved branch default. Device calibration will not be changed.

resetDeviceCalibration.title: Reset device calibration?
resetDeviceCalibration.body: Printer alignment on this device will return to its defaults. The saved branch label design will not change.

removeLogo.title: Remove logo?
removeLogo.body: The logo will disappear from the draft and future documents after you save.

removeReceipt.title: Remove receipt?
removeReceipt.body: The attached receipt will be removed from this expense draft.

cancel.title: Cancel this action?
cancel.body: Any unfinished changes will be lost.

restoreDefaults.title: Restore defaults?
restoreDefaults.body: Your custom settings will be replaced with the defaults.

signOut.title: Sign out?
signOut.body: You will need to sign in again to use Kubri.

retry.title: Try again?
retry.body: Kubri will repeat the last safe action.
